objective.primaryRule: none: a bounded fixed-arm comparison (L0/L1/L2 Growth funding lifecycles) and diagnostic of frozen, unchanged phenotypes; nothing is searched, selected or tuned; interpretation rules R1–R6 (PROTOCOL.md §11) are descriptive

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: no search (0 proposals). Frozen ceilings (brief §9): 20,000 fresh development simulations and 200 full-history simulations. Planned: development 14,563 (V 353, C 130, N 12,160 fresh with 5,120 archived L0 draws read, S 1,920), full 49. Consistency rounds inside an L1/L2 evaluation, Growth book re-simulations, archive reads and retries are disclosed apart. About 390 engineering pilot evaluations ran before the freeze (mechanics only).

deviations.description: no search, no earlier-cutoff repetition, no primary or roles (also §2.3–§2.5, §3.2, §4)
deviations.justification: a fixed-arm comparison of frozen subjects (diagnostic scope, §0.1); the brief: 'a fixed-arm architecture comparison and diagnostic, without a parameter search … Do not repeat full historical-cutoff optimization searches'

deviations.description: the §5.1 gates precede a large search, and there is none; stage V (L0 reproduction of sealed records, L0 book parity of the lifecycle engine, causal prefixes, accounting, single-book identities, invariance) replaces them; no execution stresses
deviations.justification: nothing is qualified or selected; the engine is Priority 3's with a bounded, verified lifecycle adapter

deviations.description: no tuning benchmark; 12 workers from Priority 3's measured saturation; the pilot reports observed use
deviations.justification: diagnostic scope (§6.3: diagnostics report observed use)

deviations.description: FULL opens only for frozen subjects and arms after the sealed development records and verdicts, behind the committed FULL_MANIFEST.json and Priority 3's guard; previously examined history
deviations.justification: brief §7: freeze and commit the full-history evaluation manifest before opening new validation results

deviations.description: a common family-level instrument for the standalone books (one Latin-hypercube column per Growth input, the same in every subject)
deviations.justification: brief §8: a common, explicitly specified family-level instrument with the same distribution, radii, sample count, seeds and boundary rules
